d:
Kartik purnima ke pavan avsar par ganga aur gandak nadiyon ke sangam ke pas aayojit hone vala vishv prasiddh hariharnath kshetr sonpur mela aaj, ravivar 22 navanbar se shuru ho raha hai. dharmik aastha, aitihasik mahatv aur gramin sanskriti ke sangam ke rup men pahchane jane vale is 32 divsiy mele ka vidhivat udghatan sham panch baje nakhas sthit paryatan vibhag ke mukhy sanskritik manch se mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri karenge.
